editor_note: Entry 38 is faithful and natural: "Membuat Backend kustom dan mentranspilasi untuknya" correctly renders "create and transpile against custom backends", and "transpiler pass kustom" matches the rest of the page.

None of the three rewritten entries would mislead a learner. Entry 19, "Memulai", is correct. Entries 68 and 72 both translate the relative clause "with which users can" as "sehingga" ("so that"). That makes the user benefit sound like a result of Q-CTRL releasing the function, not something the tool itself allows. In entry 72 the bare English "objective" (and "graph") also reads awkwardly; "fungsi objektif" would be more natural. "Fungsi circuit" is used consistently with the rest of the file.

examples.source: Q-CTRL is releasing an optimization solver with which users can pass a graph or an objective, and receive solution costs.
examples.translation: Q-CTRL merilis solver optimasi sehingga pengguna dapat memberikan sebuah graph atau objective, dan menerima biaya solusi.
examples.suggested: Q-CTRL merilis solver optimasi yang memungkinkan pengguna memberikan sebuah graf atau fungsi objektif, lalu menerima biaya solusi.
examples.why: "sehingga" (so that) makes the benefit a consequence of the release rather than a capability of the solver. Bare "objective" is unnatural in Indonesian prose, while "fungsi objektif" is the standard term.

examples.source: Q-CTRL is releasing a circuit function that applies AI-driven quantum control techniques, with which users can scale successfully to larger problems.
examples.translation: Q-CTRL merilis fungsi circuit yang menerapkan teknik kontrol kuantum berbasis AI, sehingga pengguna dapat berhasil menskalakan ke masalah yang lebih besar.
examples.suggested: Q-CTRL merilis fungsi circuit yang menerapkan teknik kontrol kuantum berbasis AI, yang memungkinkan pengguna berhasil menangani masalah berskala lebih besar.
examples.why: "sehingga" misrenders the relative "with which", and "menskalakan ke masalah yang lebih besar" is a calque. The meaning still comes through.

editor_note: I only judged the rewritten entry 26. It renders the heading "Dynamical Decoupling" as "Dekopling Dinamis", but entry 24, the sentence that introduces this section, keeps the term in English as "dynamical decoupling", as do its sibling headings "Twirling" and "TREX + ZNE". "Dekopling" is also an unusual loanword that Indonesian quantum practitioners rarely use. The meaning is not wrong, so a learner would not be misled. The split is still a within-file inconsistency: a reader could fail to connect the heading with the technique that entry 24 lists and the other error-mitigation guides name.

examples.source: Dynamical Decoupling {#dynamical-decoupling}
examples.translation: Dekopling Dinamis {#dynamical-decoupling}
examples.suggested: Dynamical decoupling {#dynamical-decoupling}
examples.why: Entry 24 keeps 'dynamical decoupling' in English, and so do the sibling headings 'Twirling' and 'TREX + ZNE'. Translating only this heading makes the term inconsistent within the file, and 'dekopling' is not a settled Indonesian term.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally: entry 23 keeps "kurang dari maksimum yang ditentukan sistem" and the administrator-contacts-IBM-support caveat, and entry 32 keeps "mana pun yang terjadi **terakhir**" and the point that the interactive TTL counts as usage. Entry 32 says "waktu nyata (wall-clock time)" while entry 52 says "waktu jam dinding". Entry 52 is outside this review's scope, and both terms are easy to recognize, so this is not a defect.

The rewritten entry 12 says the same thing as the English and would not mislead a learner. For example, "deep circuits" becomes "Circuit dengan kedalaman tinggi", "unbiased expectation values" becomes "nilai ekspektasi tak bias", and the zero-overhead caveat about working with any observable weight is kept. The one problem is that the table's header row was left in English ("Name | Provider | Recommended use | Unique benefits"). The matching table in entry 15 translates the same header as "Nama | Provider | Penggunaan yang disarankan | Keunggulan unik", so the two tables on this page don't match.

examples.source: | Name | Provider | Recommended use | Unique benefits |
examples.translation: | Name | Provider | Recommended use | Unique benefits |
examples.suggested: | Nama | Provider | Penggunaan yang disarankan | Keunggulan unik |
examples.why: The header was left in English, but the same header in the Application functions table (entry 15) is translated, so the two tables on the page don't match.

editor_note: None of the three rewritten entries (5, 6, 26) would mislead a learner. All of the English content is there: client-side primitives, delegation to the Executor primitive, and the claim that only the import statement changes. Entry 5 renders "finer control" as "kontrol yang lebih baik" ("better control"). That drops the idea of more detailed control, so "kontrol yang lebih terperinci" would be closer. Entry 6's "dengan satu-satunya perubahan adalah pernyataan import" follows the English syntax too closely, and entry 26's "Tinjau [contoh-contoh] detail" is stiff because "detail" is left dangling after the link.

examples.source: faster debugging feedback, and finer control.
examples.translation: umpan balik debugging yang lebih cepat, dan kontrol yang lebih baik.
examples.suggested: umpan balik debugging yang lebih cepat, dan kontrol yang lebih terperinci.
examples.why: 'Finer' means more detailed control, not simply 'better' control. The meaning shifts a little but does not mislead.

examples.source: with the only change being the import statement.
examples.translation: dengan satu-satunya perubahan adalah pernyataan import.
examples.suggested: dan satu-satunya yang perlu diubah hanyalah pernyataan import.
examples.why: This copies the English 'with ... being' construction. It is grammatical but reads stiffly in Indonesian.

examples.source: Review detailed [examples](sampler-examples).
examples.translation: Tinjau [contoh-contoh](sampler-examples) detail.
examples.suggested: Tinjau [contoh-contoh terperinci](sampler-examples).
examples.why: Leaving the modifier 'detail' after the link is awkward. The adjective belongs with the noun, preferably as 'terperinci'.

editor_note: Rewritten entry 3 is faithful and natural: "Qiskit Function dari Global Data Quantum" renders "by" correctly, keeps the product and brand names in English, and leaves the anchor unchanged.

The meaning is faithful throughout. The compatibility claims in [10]/[35] (NoiseLearner only with legacy server-side Estimator, NoiseLearnerV3 only with Executor and client-side Estimator), the underscore/hyphen caveat in [28] and the two-qubit Pauli-Lindblad restriction in [38] are all rendered accurately. However, the page title 'directed execution model' is left in English inside the prose link in [7] but translated as 'Model eksekusi terarah' in the references list [43], so the same guide appears under two names. 'Convenience methods' in [17] became 'Metode praktis', which is a little stiff; 'Metode bantu' reads more naturally.

examples.source: [directed execution model](/guides/directed-execution-model)
examples.translation: [directed execution model](/guides/directed-execution-model)
examples.suggested: [model eksekusi terarah](/guides/directed-execution-model)
examples.why: Entry [43] translates the same guide title as 'Model eksekusi terarah', so this link should use the same Indonesian name.

examples.source: Convenience methods are available for generating the annotated boxes
examples.translation: Metode praktis tersedia untuk menghasilkan box yang dianotasi
examples.suggested: Tersedia metode bantu untuk membuat box yang dianotasi
examples.why: 'Metode praktis' is a literal calque, and the subject-first word order is stiff. 'Metode bantu' is the more natural term in Indonesian technical writing.

editor_note: None of the four rewritten entries misleads a learner: entries 0, 1 and 3 are accurate, and entry 4 keeps every claim, including "sebagian berkat" for "thanks in part". Entry 4 has two small wording problems. It uses "dinamis" for both "vibrant" and "dynamic" in back-to-back sentences, so the adjective repeats and the nuance of "vibrant" is lost. The phrase "mencakup menjadikan ... sebagai open source" also reads stiffly. Separately, headings 1 and 3 say "Sumber terbuka" while entries 0 and 4 keep "open source". That split is defensible, but a native editor might align it.

examples.source: thanks in part to its vibrant community. The Qiskit community is a dynamic and welcoming group
examples.translation: sebagian berkat komunitasnya yang dinamis. Komunitas Qiskit adalah kelompok ... yang dinamis dan ramah
examples.suggested: sebagian berkat komunitasnya yang aktif dan bersemangat.
examples.why: Two different English adjectives both become 'dinamis' in adjacent sentences, so the word repeats and the sense of 'vibrant' is lost.

examples.source: This groundbreaking initiative includes open-sourcing key parts of the quantum software stack
examples.translation: Inisiatif terobosan ini mencakup menjadikan bagian-bagian penting dari stack perangkat lunak kuantum sebagai open source
examples.suggested: Inisiatif terobosan ini mencakup pembukaan kode sumber (open source) bagian-bagian penting dari stack perangkat lunak kuantum
examples.why: 'mencakup menjadikan' puts two verbs side by side, which is a calque of the English gerund. A noun phrase after 'mencakup' reads more naturally.

editor_note: Both rewritten headings mean the same as the English, so neither would mislead a learner. The problem is that they now break the naming pattern used everywhere else on the page. Entry 3 turns the product name into Indonesian word order, "Server MCP Qiskit", but the page title (entry 1) and the body (entries 0, 4, 6, 30, 36) keep the proper name "Qiskit MCP Servers". Entry 28, "Server MCP Qiskit Gym", no longer matches its sibling headings, which all keep the English pattern: "Qiskit MCP Server" (18), "Qiskit Runtime MCP Server" (20), "Qiskit Docs MCP Server" (22) and "Qiskit IBM Transpiler MCP Server" (24).

examples.source: Qiskit MCP Servers {#qiskit-mcp-servers}
examples.translation: Server MCP Qiskit {#qiskit-mcp-servers}
examples.suggested: Qiskit MCP Servers {#qiskit-mcp-servers}
examples.why: 'Qiskit MCP Servers' is the project's proper name. The title (entry 1) and all body text keep it unchanged, so this H1 alone uses a different form.

examples.source: Qiskit Gym MCP Server {#qiskit-gym-mcp-server}
examples.translation: Server MCP Qiskit Gym {#qiskit-gym-mcp-server}
examples.suggested: Qiskit Gym MCP Server {#qiskit-gym-mcp-server}
examples.why: The sibling server headings (entries 18, 20, 22, 24) all keep the English product-name order, e.g. 'Qiskit Runtime MCP Server'. Reordering only this one makes the list inconsistent.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally. In entry 3, "Keduanya menyediakan implementasi yang lebih canggih (misalnya, dengan menyertakan mitigasi error)" keeps the meaning, and "kelas dasar primitif", "nilai ekspektasi" and "hardware IBM Quantum®" match the rest of the page. Entry 9's five recommendation bullets map one to one, and "Estimator, Executor, dan Sampler" keeps the source's order.

The rewritten heading in entry 23 gives "Dynamical decoupling" as "Dekopling dinamis". The paragraph right above it (entry 22) keeps the English "dynamical decoupling", and the section after it keeps "Twirling". So the learner meets the term in English in the prose and then under a translated name in the heading that should match it. "Dekopling" is also not a settled Indonesian word; the field keeps "dynamical decoupling" in English. It does not mislead, but for consistency the heading should go back to "Dynamical decoupling".

examples.source: Dynamical decoupling {#dynamical-decoupling}
examples.translation: Dekopling dinamis {#dynamical-decoupling}
examples.suggested: Dynamical decoupling {#dynamical-decoupling}
examples.why: Entry 22 introduces the technique as 'dynamical decoupling' (English), and the sibling heading 'Twirling' is kept in English. The translated 'Dekopling dinamis' is a non-standard coinage and breaks consistency within the file. It is still recognizable, so this is minor.

editor_note: The four rewritten link labels are faithful and follow the page's "Addon Qiskit <name>" pattern, for example "propagasi balik operator (OBP)", "pemeta fermionik" and "pemeta optimasi". The capitalized "Circuit" left in entry 6 is for the separate leak sweep.

None of the five rewritten entries (5, 8, 22, 25, 26) would mislead a learner. They keep the key points: ecosystem projects are "bukan bagian dari Qiskit itu sendiri", IBM-maintained projects are contrasted with community-supported ones, and the M3 method "secara nominal konvergen dalam O(1) langkah". Two small wording fixes remain. In entry 8, "dan banyak komponen lain yang berantarmuka dengannya" has a stray "yang" that turns the final clause into a noun phrase with no verb. In entry 26, "menyelesaikan probabilitas pengukuran" copies the English "solves for" word for word and reads unnaturally. "menghitung" would be the natural verb here.

examples.source: and many other components interface with it.
examples.translation: dan banyak komponen lain yang berantarmuka dengannya.
examples.suggested: dan banyak komponen lain berantarmuka dengannya.
examples.why: The relative 'yang' leaves the final coordinated clause without a verb. It becomes a dangling noun phrase instead of a statement.

examples.source: a measurement mitigation technique that solves for corrected measurement probabilities
examples.translation: teknik mitigasi pengukuran yang menyelesaikan probabilitas pengukuran yang dikoreksi
examples.suggested: teknik mitigasi pengukuran yang menghitung probabilitas pengukuran terkoreksi
examples.why: 'menyelesaikan probabilitas' copies 'solve for' literally. You solve (menyelesaikan) an equation, not a probability. 'menghitung' is the natural verb.

editor_note: None of the 5 rewritten entries would mislead a learner. Their meaning matches the English: the barrier/if_test explanation (6), the "less interesting but still interesting" argument (20), the I/X/Z/XZ Bell-state shift (32) and the 85% vs 75% win rates (66). One problem is terminology. The rewritten heading in entry 17 translates the protocol name as "Pengodean superdense", but the body text (entries 18, 20, 21, 23, 42, 43, 49) keeps "superdense coding" in English, so the heading and the text use different names for the same protocol. The other problem is phrasing. In entry 20, "untuk waktu yang bisa kita perkirakan" is a stiff calque of "for the foreseeable future", and it sits in a long clause with no pause before "sehingga".

examples.source: Superdense coding {#superdense-coding}
examples.translation: Pengodean superdense {#superdense-coding}
examples.suggested: Superdense coding {#superdense-coding}
examples.why: Every body entry keeps 'superdense coding' in English, including the later heading 'Implementasi superdense coding' (42), so this one heading names the protocol differently.

examples.source: Sending qubits is likely to be so much more difficult than sending classical bits for the foreseeable future that trading ...
examples.translation: Mengirimkan qubit kemungkinan akan jauh lebih sulit daripada mengirimkan bit klasik untuk waktu yang bisa kita perkirakan sehingga menukar ...
examples.suggested: Setidaknya di masa mendatang yang dapat diperkirakan, mengirimkan qubit kemungkinan besar jauh lebih sulit daripada mengirimkan bit klasik, sehingga menukar ...
examples.why: 'untuk waktu yang bisa kita perkirakan' is a literal calque of 'for the foreseeable future'. Moving the time phrase to the front and adding a comma before 'sehingga' reads more naturally.

editor_note: Entries 4 and 5 are faithful and read naturally: "keadaan kuantum sebagai vektor dengan entri bilangan kompleks" and "matriks uniter" are correct, "satu sistem ditinjau secara terisolasi" keeps the isolation condition, and "saling berkorelasi" keeps the multi-system caveat.

All 13 rewritten entries keep the English meaning, and none of them would mislead a learner. The workspace-qubit cost caveat (41), the leftover $|a\rangle,|b\rangle$ qubits (18), the $y = 0^m$ / phase kickback option (39) and the "garbage (sampah)" naming joke (29) all come through intact. Terms are used consistently: qubit workspace, gate controlled-NOT, keadaan basis standar, query gate. Two phrasings read as calques. In entry 41, "yang memerlukan biaya membuat sirkuit lebih besar" is stiff. In entry 26, "Kita bisa memaksanya terjadi seperti ini jika mau" keeps English word order and says "seperti ini" twice in the same sentence.

examples.source: (which come at a cost of making the circuits larger)
examples.translation: (yang memerlukan biaya membuat sirkuit lebih besar)
examples.suggested: (dengan konsekuensi sirkuitnya menjadi lebih besar)
examples.why: This is a literal calque of 'come at a cost of'. 'memerlukan biaya membuat' sounds like a monetary cost and reads stiffly.

examples.source: We can force this to happen if we wish by rearranging the qubits using SWAP gates, which can be implemented with three controlled-NOT gates like this:
examples.translation: Kita bisa memaksanya terjadi seperti ini jika mau dengan mengatur ulang qubit menggunakan gate SWAP, yang bisa diimplementasikan dengan tiga gate controlled-NOT seperti ini:
examples.suggested: Jika mau, kita bisa memastikan susunan ini dengan mengatur ulang qubit menggunakan gate SWAP, yang bisa diimplementasikan dengan tiga gate controlled-NOT seperti berikut:
examples.why: It follows English word order and uses 'seperti ini' twice in one sentence. Moving 'jika mau' to the front and swapping one 'seperti ini' for 'seperti berikut' reads naturally.

editor_note: Entries 3, 4, 5 and 8 keep the English meaning, including the caveat "umumnya mengubah atau menghancurkannya" and the known-collection vs. unknown-single-state contrast between "diskriminasi keadaan kuantum" and "tomografi keadaan kuantum", and "pengukuran proyektif", "pengukuran basis standar" and "matriks densitas" are used consistently.

Entry 8 is faithful and natural. "Misalkan ... matriks densitas yang merepresentasikan keadaan kuantum dari sistem yang sama" and "*Fidelitas* ... didefinisikan menggunakan trace (Tr)" keep the English meaning and the math unchanged, and they match the page's use of fidelitas, matriks densitas and trace.

Both rewritten entries match the English in informal "kamu/-mu" register: [5] "Masukanmu akan digunakan untuk meningkatkan konten dan pengalaman pengguna kami" and [12] "pemroses data pihak ketiga yang diotorisasi oleh IBM… dibagikan ke Credly", which keeps every data category and privacy caveat.

None of the six rewritten entries changes the meaning. Entries 26, 27, 57 and 68 are clean ("Uji pemahamanmu", "kamu bebas menonton seluruh video"), and "terikat"/"Keterikatan" for entangled/entanglement matches the rest of the file. The scarf analogy in entry 53 reads as machine translation in two places. "bersama-sama tampak ungu" has no subject, and "memegang dua selendang ini direntangkan" is ungrammatical. Entry 24 copies English word order in "memungkinkan secara eksponensial banyak keadaan logis sekaligus" and translates "powerful feat" word for word as "prestasi yang kuat".

examples.source: When the friends lay the scarves on top of each other, together they appear purple. If the friends hold these two scarves stretched between them
examples.translation: Ketika teman-teman menumpukkan selendang di atas satu sama lain, bersama-sama tampak ungu. Jika teman-teman memegang dua selendang ini direntangkan di antara mereka
examples.suggested: Ketika kedua teman itu menumpuk selendangnya, keduanya tampak ungu. Jika mereka membentangkan kedua selendang itu di antara mereka
examples.why: The first clause has no subject, and 'memegang ... direntangkan' is ungrammatical. It reads as machine translation, although the meaning survives.

examples.source: allows for exponentially many logical states at once. This is a powerful feat
examples.translation: memungkinkan secara eksponensial banyak keadaan logis sekaligus. Ini adalah prestasi yang kuat
examples.suggested: memungkinkan jumlah keadaan logis yang eksponensial sekaligus. Ini kemampuan yang luar biasa
examples.why: The adverb placement copies English word order, and 'prestasi yang kuat' is a word-for-word rendering of 'powerful feat'.

editor_note: All six rewritten entries (24, 40, 41, 67, 68, 151) keep the English meaning. I found no drift: "Both suffer from potential trainability issues" becomes "Keduanya rentan terhadap…", which keeps the hedge, and the optimizer taxonomy and the list of minimize() arguments are intact. What remains is naturalness. Entry 151 renders "sorted into … groups" as "diurutkan" (put in order) where "dikelompokkan" (grouped) is meant. Entries 41 and 67 carry English calques: "Ini mengambil sebagai argumen", "dari mana pencarian dimulai" and "Seseorang bisa menggunakan".

examples.source: can be sorted into relatively few groups of commuting Pauli operators
examples.translation: bisa diurutkan menjadi relatif sedikit kelompok operator Pauli yang saling komutasi
examples.suggested: bisa dikelompokkan menjadi relatif sedikit kelompok operator Pauli yang saling komutasi
examples.why: 'Diurutkan' means ordering or ranking. The source means partitioning into groups, so 'dikelompokkan' is the right verb.

examples.source: This takes as its arguments: … A set of parameters from which to begin the search.
examples.translation: Ini mengambil sebagai argumen: … Sebuah set parameter dari mana pencarian dimulai.
examples.suggested: Fungsi ini menerima argumen berikut: … Sekumpulan parameter awal sebagai titik mulai pencarian.
examples.why: Both phrases follow English word order ('takes as its arguments', 'from which'). A native technical writer would recast them.

examples.source: One can simply use Estimator directly, but Estimator returns much more…
examples.translation: Seseorang bisa menggunakan Estimator secara langsung, tapi…
examples.suggested: Estimator memang bisa digunakan langsung, tapi…
examples.why: 'Seseorang' is a literal calque of the generic English 'one'. An Indonesian writer would use a passive or 'kita'.

editor_note: Entry 11 ("Yuk, bergabunglah bersama kami ... membawa quantum advantage semakin dekat") is faithful and natural in the kamu register. Entry 9 is faithful overall, with two small slips. "coming within reach" became "kian mendekati jangkauan", a stiff calque that a native editor would change to "kian dapat dijangkau". "Widely applicable" became "sudah banyak diterapkan", which means "already widely applied". That makes the claim slightly stronger, but not enough to mislead a learner.

examples.source: increasingly advanced forms of error correction are steadily coming within reach
examples.translation: bentuk-bentuk error correction yang semakin canggih kian mendekati jangkauan
examples.suggested: bentuk-bentuk error correction yang semakin canggih kian dapat dijangkau
examples.why: 'mendekati jangkauan' is a literal calque of 'coming within reach' and reads awkwardly. 'kian dapat dijangkau' is the idiomatic Indonesian.

examples.source: Suppression and mitigation are widely applicable today
examples.translation: Suppression dan mitigation sudah banyak diterapkan saat ini
examples.suggested: Suppression dan mitigation dapat diterapkan secara luas saat ini
examples.why: 'Applicable' (can be applied) became 'diterapkan' (are applied). This is a slight strengthening, from possible use to actual widespread use.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. Negations and conditions carry over correctly, including the commutation argument in [265]/[270], the p→1 dephasing subtlety in [227] and the SPAM caveats. However, the page reads as if several translators worked on it without a shared glossary, and the terms and register change at section boundaries. Up to about [72] it uses "quantum state", "kamu", "lesson" and "noise model". From [75] on it switches to "keadaan kuantum", "Anda", "pelajaran" and "model noise". From [284] on "circuit" becomes "sirkuit", "gate" becomes "gerbang", "kita" becomes "Kami", and "menjalar" becomes "merambat". "Incoherent" also appears both as "tidak koheren" and "inkoheren". There are also a few small slips: "switching power lines" is rendered as "saluran listrik yang berpindah" ("power lines that move"), the √N scaling as "sebesar √N" ("by an amount √N"), and "heads" as "kepala" where the Indonesian coin-toss term would be "gambar/angka".

examples.source: entangling gates shown as acting on the adjacent qubits in the circuit diagram would end up requiring SWAP gates
examples.translation: gerbang entangling yang ditunjukkan bekerja pada qubit yang berdekatan dalam diagram sirkuit akan berakhir membutuhkan gerbang SWAP
examples.suggested: gate entangling yang ditunjukkan bekerja pada qubit yang berdekatan dalam diagram circuit akan berakhir membutuhkan gate SWAP
examples.why: The rest of the file keeps 'gate' and 'circuit'. The last section switches to 'gerbang'/'sirkuit' and also uses 'Kami' ([285]) instead of 'kita', so the terms are inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: theoretically that gate rotates a quantum state by angle π radians
examples.translation: secara teoritis gate tersebut merotasi keadaan kuantum dengan sudut π radian
examples.suggested: secara teoritis gate tersebut merotasi quantum state dengan sudut π radian
examples.why: Entries [0]-[72] use 'quantum state', 'quantum' and 'kamu'. From here on the file uses 'keadaan kuantum', 'kuantum' and 'Anda', which is a visible mid-page change of glossary and register.

examples.source: external electromagnetic (EM) fields from switching power lines
examples.translation: medan elektromagnetik (EM) eksternal dari saluran listrik yang berpindah
examples.suggested: medan elektromagnetik (EM) eksternal dari switching pada saluran listrik
examples.why: 'Switching' here means current being switched on and off, not power lines that move ('berpindah'). This is a literal mistranslation.

examples.source: the distinguishability between outcomes improves only as √N
examples.translation: keterbedaan antar outcome hanya membaik sebesar √N
examples.suggested: keterbedaan antar outcome hanya membaik sebanding dengan √N
examples.why: 'sebesar' means 'by an amount of'. The English describes a scaling law, and 'sebanding dengan' expresses that correctly.

examples.source: Incoherent errors
examples.translation: Error inkoheren
examples.suggested: Error tidak koheren
examples.why: Entries [85]-[113] use 'tidak koheren'. From [186] on the file uses 'inkoheren', and 'quantum channel' also becomes 'channel kuantum', so the same terms appear in two forms.

editor_note: None of the 25 rewritten entries changes the meaning. The H-on-|1⟩ sign caveat (60), the X-then-H recipe for |−⟩ (55), the |α|²/|β|² measurement probabilities (93) and the non-separability argument (145) all match the English. The first problem is a "state" inconsistency. Entries 29 and 61 write "Keadaan quantum single-qubit", but entries 18, 19, 24 and 66 use "keadaan kuantum", so the same phrase appears two ways. The second problem is word order in the coin-flip analogy in entry 101: "tepat 50 masing-masing sisi" follows English order and reads awkwardly in Indonesian.

examples.source: A single-qubit quantum state is also represented as
examples.translation: Keadaan quantum single-qubit juga direpresentasikan sebagai
examples.suggested: Keadaan kuantum single-qubit juga direpresentasikan sebagai
examples.why: Entries 19, 24 and 66 write 'keadaan kuantum', so this should match them. The same mismatch appears in the heading in entry 61 ('Keadaan quantum single-qubit dan evolusi uniter').

examples.source: Just as 100 flips of a coin would rarely yield exactly 50 instances of each side.
examples.translation: Sama seperti 100 lemparan koin yang jarang menghasilkan tepat 50 masing-masing sisi.
examples.suggested: Sama seperti 100 kali lemparan koin jarang menghasilkan masing-masing sisi tepat 50 kali.
examples.why: 'tepat 50 masing-masing sisi' keeps the English word order, and the relative clause 'yang jarang' makes the sentence incomplete. The suggested version reads naturally and keeps the point of the analogy.

editor_note: The rewritten entry 52, "Di sini kita membangun sebuah Circuit untuk satu langkah waktu menggunakan Lie–Trotter", is faithful and natural: "single time step" becomes "satu langkah waktu" and "construct" becomes "membangun", both matching entry 69 ("bangun Circuit untuk satu langkah waktu").

None of the 9 rewritten entries changes the meaning. Entries 27, 57, 80, 99, 114 and 116 keep their caveats, conditions and maths intact, for example "bukannya $0$ dan $1$" and "suku bebas". There are three small fixes. Entry 135 opens with the English "Primitives", but the rest of the file uses "primitif", so it is inconsistent. Entry 20 renders "run" as "jalannya" ("pada setiap jalannya", "Semakin banyak jalannya"), which reads awkwardly. Entry 17 translates "given a quantum circuit" word for word as "diberikan sebuah Circuit kuantum", which sounds stiff.

examples.source: Primitives allow for the use of error suppression techniques...
examples.translation: Primitives memungkinkan penggunaan teknik error suppression...
examples.suggested: Primitif memungkinkan penggunaan teknik error suppression...
examples.why: Everywhere else the file uses 'primitif' (entries 5, 10, 13, 127, 146), so the English plural here is inconsistent.

examples.source: performing measurements on each run... The more runs (or *shots*) it performs
examples.translation: melakukan pengukuran pada setiap jalannya... Semakin banyak jalannya (atau *shot*)
examples.suggested: melakukan pengukuran pada setiap eksekusi... Semakin banyak eksekusi (atau *shot*) yang dilakukan
examples.why: 'jalannya' means 'its course/progress'. It is not a natural word for one circuit run and makes the sentence awkward.

examples.source: given a quantum circuit that prepares the state $|\psi\rangle$
examples.translation: diberikan sebuah Circuit kuantum yang mempersiapkan keadaan $|\psi\rangle$
examples.suggested: jika diberikan sebuah Circuit kuantum yang menyiapkan keadaan $|\psi\rangle$
examples.why: A bare 'diberikan' copies the English 'given' construction. Adding 'jika' (or 'untuk') and using 'menyiapkan' reads more naturally.

editor_note: Entries 7, 22 and 68 are faithful and natural. Entry 16 keeps the CVaR meaning correct: α=1 is the expected value, α=0 is the minimum, and CVaR is the average of the α best shots. It still has three things a native editor would fix. "CVaR mencapai ini" is a calque of "accomplishes this". "Pertukaran" (which means "exchange") is used for "tradeoff" where "kompromi" is the natural word, and "sedikit perataan" can read as "flattening" rather than averaging. Also, "error mitigation" appears as "mitigasi kesalahan" here but as "mitigasi error" in entry 51.

examples.source: The CVaR accomplishes this.
examples.translation: CVaR mencapai ini.
examples.suggested: CVaR mewujudkan hal tersebut.
examples.why: Literal calque of 'accomplishes this'. A native technical writer would not write 'mencapai ini' with a demonstrative object like this.

examples.source: is a tradeoff between focusing on better shots, while still applying some averaging to smooth out the optimization landscape
examples.translation: merupakan pertukaran antara berfokus pada shots yang lebih baik, sambil tetap melakukan sedikit perataan untuk memuluskan lanskap optimasi
examples.suggested: merupakan kompromi antara berfokus pada shots yang lebih baik dan tetap melakukan sedikit perata-rataan untuk memuluskan lanskap optimasi
examples.why: 'Pertukaran' means exchange, not tradeoff, and 'perataan' can be read as flattening rather than averaging. 'Kompromi' and 'perata-rataan' say what is meant.

examples.source: the CVaR can be used as an error mitigation technique
examples.translation: teknik mitigasi kesalahan
examples.suggested: teknik mitigasi error
examples.why: Entry 51 renders the same term as 'mitigasi error'. The two entries should use one rendering.

editor_note: Rewritten entries 7 and 38 are faithful: "nilai ekspektasi dari beberapa observabel pada sapuan parameter dalam satu panggilan" and "mengevaluasi Circuit berparameter pada banyak nilai parameter dalam satu panggilan" keep every claim, and sapuan/menyapu matches entries 28, 49 and 62.

The meaning holds throughout. The variational-bound logic, the reason M_J is applied at the product stage, and the first-order vs exact angle argument all come through intact. One wording problem needs attention: "rigorous upper bound" is rendered as "batas atas yang ketat" in [108], [121], [130] and [134]. In Indonesian math, "ketat" can also mean a tight bound, and [130] then reads as "remains tight but may be less accurate", which is close to contradictory; "batas atas yang rigoris/terjamin" would be safer. From about [105] onward, terminology also changes against the first half: Step→Langkah, valence→valensi, determinant→determinan, occupancy→okupansi, parity→paritas, fermionic→fermionik, nukleus→inti, depth→kedalaman. Finally, [61] reverses the direction of "the test all four quantum numbers reduce to" ("menjadi dasar"), and [177] contains the awkward phrase "tetap sempurna baik-baik saja".

examples.source: The bound remains rigorous but can be less accurate than a bound computed from all the sampled configurations.
examples.translation: Batasnya tetap ketat tapi bisa jadi kurang akurat dibanding batas yang dihitung dari semua konfigurasi yang di-sampling.
examples.suggested: Batasnya tetap rigoris (tetap merupakan batas atas yang sah) tetapi bisa kurang akurat dibanding batas yang dihitung dari semua konfigurasi yang di-sampling.
examples.why: 'ketat' can be read as a tight bound, which clashes with 'less accurate' and overstates the guarantee. The same rendering appears in [108], [121] and [134].

examples.source: Check the ISA depth in Step 2
examples.translation: Periksa kedalaman ISA di Langkah 2
examples.suggested: Use one convention for the whole file: either 'Step 2' with 'depth' or 'Langkah 2' with 'kedalaman'.
examples.why: The first half of the file uses 'Step 2' and 'depth' ([72], [75], [87]), and the second half switches to 'Langkah' and 'kedalaman'. Valence/valensi, determinant/determinan and occupancy/okupansi split the same way.

examples.source: `symmetry_allowed` is the integer test that all four exact quantum numbers reduce to.
examples.translation: `symmetry_allowed` adalah tes integer yang menjadi dasar keempat bilangan kuantum eksak tersebut.
examples.suggested: `symmetry_allowed` adalah tes integer yang menjadi bentuk akhir dari keempat pemeriksaan bilangan kuantum eksak tersebut.
examples.why: The translation says the test is the basis of the quantum numbers. The source says the reverse: the four quantum-number checks all come down to this one integer test.

examples.source: the proton half at $M_p = +1$ is perfectly good once it is paired with a neutron half at $M_n = -1$
examples.translation: setengah proton pada $M_p = +1$ tetap sempurna baik-baik saja setelah dipasangkan
examples.suggested: setengah proton pada $M_p = +1$ tetap sepenuhnya valid setelah dipasangkan
examples.why: 'sempurna baik-baik saja' is a clumsy literal stacking of 'perfectly good'.

editor_note: All three rewritten entries match the English: "meminimalkan kuadrat pelanggaran kendala (fungsi biaya)" in [21], QUBO kept in English in [23], and the 1 to Wilayah A / 0 to Wilayah B mapping in [53], which agrees with [17].

None of the 11 rewritten entries changes the meaning. The loss-function definition (41/43/46), the max_iter caveat (48) and the swap-search post-processing (52) all match the English. The problems are inconsistencies with the rest of the page. Entry 38 leaves "state" in English, but entry 29 says "keadaan kuantum". Entries 43 and 50 use "mengenkode", but the page otherwise uses "mengkodekan". Entries 6 and 12 keep "multi-body", while entry 14 already uses "dua-bodi" and "k-bodi".

examples.source: Here, the state $|\psi \rangle$ is parameterized with $\mathbf{\theta}$
examples.translation: Di sini, state $|\psi \rangle$ diparameterisasi dengan $\mathbf{\theta}$
examples.suggested: Di sini, keadaan $|\psi \rangle$ diparameterisasi dengan $\mathbf{\theta}$
examples.why: Entry 29 renders 'quantum state' as 'keadaan kuantum'. Leaving 'state' in English here is inconsistent.

examples.source: expectation values of the Pauli strings encoding the nodes
examples.translation: nilai ekspektasi string Pauli yang mengenkode simpul-simpul tersebut
examples.suggested: nilai ekspektasi string Pauli yang mengkodekan simpul-simpul tersebut
examples.why: Entries 43 and 50 use 'mengenkode', but entries 0, 12, 27 and 29 use 'mengkodekan'. The verb should be the same throughout.

examples.source: how multi-body Pauli strings enable polynomial compression
examples.translation: bagaimana string Pauli multi-body memungkinkan kompresi polinomial
examples.suggested: bagaimana string Pauli multi-bodi memungkinkan kompresi polinomial
examples.why: Entry 14 already uses 'dua-bodi' and 'k-bodi'. Keeping 'multi-body' in English in entries 6 and 12 is inconsistent with that.

editor_note: Neither rewritten entry would mislead a learner. Entry 82 keeps the direction of the fallback right: operators on more qubits than the cap fall back to the looser triangle-inequality bound. Its "jumlah maksimum qubit di mana ... dievaluasi" is a calque of the English relative clause. Entry 131 drops its opening framing sentence ("We also choose the learning depths deliberately."), so the paragraph starts abruptly with "Temuan praktis ...:". The technical claims survive: match the deepest learning depth to the circuit depth, and set it to half the two-qubit-layer depth because the depths count layer pairs.

examples.source: We also choose the learning depths deliberately. A practical finding for learning-based mitigation with `samplomatic` is that ...
examples.translation: Temuan praktis untuk mitigasi berbasis learning dengan `samplomatic`: sangat menguntungkan jika ...
examples.suggested: Kita juga memilih kedalaman learning secara sengaja. Temuan praktis untuk mitigasi berbasis learning dengan `samplomatic` adalah bahwa sangat menguntungkan jika ...
examples.why: The opening sentence was dropped. It links this paragraph to the learning-depth option listed in entry 130 and signals that the value is chosen on purpose, not left at a default. Without it the paragraph starts abruptly.

examples.source: the maximum number of qubits for which the tighter, eigenvalue-based (L2-norm) bound is evaluated
examples.translation: jumlah maksimum qubit di mana bound yang lebih ketat berbasis eigenvalue (norma L2) dievaluasi
examples.suggested: jumlah qubit maksimum yang masih dievaluasi dengan bound berbasis eigenvalue (norma L2) yang lebih ketat
examples.why: Using "di mana" as a relative pronoun calques English "for which". A native technical writer would restructure the clause.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, including the 1/((1-α)(1-β)) postselection cost, the γ²=100 to about 6.3 overhead reduction, and the QED+PEC convergence claims. Core terms are consistent (postseleksi, kanal noise, nilai ekspektasi, qubit mediator). A native editor would still fix a few calques. "baked into the circuit" became "dipanggang ke dalam circuit". "tighter error bars" became "error bar yang lebih ketat" when it should be "lebih sempit". "past 50 qubits or so" became "di atas 50 qubit atau lebih", which misreads "or so" (roughly) as "or more". "some subset" became the redundant "sebagian subset". None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: rather than being baked into the circuit
examples.translation: bukan dipanggang ke dalam circuit
examples.suggested: bukan ditanamkan secara tetap ke dalam circuit
examples.why: Literal calque of the English idiom 'baked into'. In Indonesian 'dipanggang' only means roasting or baking food.

examples.source: tighter error bars
examples.translation: error bar yang lebih ketat
examples.suggested: error bar yang lebih sempit
examples.why: Error bars are narrow or wide. 'Ketat' is a calque of 'tight'.

examples.source: to scale up past 50 qubits or so
examples.translation: untuk skala di atas 50 qubit atau lebih
examples.suggested: untuk skala di atas sekitar 50 qubit
examples.why: 'Or so' means approximately, but 'atau lebih' reads as 'or more'. This is a small misreading and is also redundant after 'di atas'.

examples.source: detecting some subset of error generators
examples.translation: mendeteksi sebagian subset dari generator kesalahan
examples.suggested: mendeteksi sebagian generator kesalahan
examples.why: 'Sebagian subset' is redundant, because 'sebagian' already means 'a subset of'.

editor_note: All 7 rewritten entries (71, 117, 142, 145, 147, 149, 153) keep the English meaning. The conditions in 117 ("tidak perlu disediakan" for the non-boxed PauliLindbladError case), the "sudah ... mendekati benchmark ideal" claim in 149 and the complementary-refinement framing in 153 all hold. There are two small wording problems. First, entries 71 and 149 write "channel inverse noise", a hybrid word order that follows neither the English term "inverse noise channel" nor proper Indonesian head-first order. The rest of the page (17, 19, 21, 41) uses "inverse noise channel", so the term is now inconsistent within the file. Second, entry 117 carries over the impersonal English "One can" as "Seseorang juga dapat memberikan", which reads as translationese next to the "Anda" used in the rest of the same paragraph.

examples.source: PNA relies on learning and propagating inverse noise channels.
examples.translation: PNA bergantung pada pembelajaran dan propagasi channel inverse noise.
examples.suggested: PNA bergantung pada pembelajaran dan propagasi inverse noise channel.
examples.why: Hybrid word order that matches neither English nor Indonesian syntax. The same concept appears as "inverse noise channel" in entries 17, 19, 21 and 41.

examples.source: propagating inverse noise channels into the observable effectively compensates for two-qubit gate errors
examples.translation: mempropagasi channel inverse noise ke dalam observable secara efektif mengompensasi error two-qubit gate
examples.suggested: mempropagasi inverse noise channel ke dalam observable secara efektif mengompensasi error two-qubit gate
examples.why: The same inconsistent hybrid rendering as in entry 71. Use the page's established form.

examples.source: One can also pass a non-boxed circuit containing `PauliLindbladError` instructions from `qiskit-aer`.
examples.translation: Seseorang juga dapat memberikan circuit yang tidak di-box yang berisi instruksi `PauliLindbladError` dari `qiskit-aer`.
examples.suggested: Anda juga dapat meneruskan circuit yang tidak di-box yang berisi instruksi `PauliLindbladError` dari `qiskit-aer`.
examples.why: "Seseorang" carries over the impersonal English "one". Indonesian technical prose would keep the "Anda" already used earlier in the same paragraph.

editor_note: None of the six rewritten entries would mislead a learner. Entries 18, 22, 38 and 42 are accurate and natural (for example "koefisien linier menghilang", "keadaan dasar kandidat", "dua lapisan QAOA, empat parameter"). Entry 15 writes "Optimisasi" where the rest of the file uses "optimasi". It also keeps the English "sustainability (keberlanjutan)" and "constraint" when the standard Indonesian words "keberlanjutan" and "kendala" are available. Entry 51 adds a gloss that is not in the source, "(yakni penurunan biaya)", and ends with the calque "pengoptimal pun mengembara" for "the optimizer wanders".

examples.source: Combinatorial optimization also appears in sustainability challenges
examples.translation: Optimisasi kombinatorial juga muncul dalam tantangan sustainability (keberlanjutan)
examples.suggested: Optimasi kombinatorial juga muncul dalam tantangan keberlanjutan
examples.why: The rest of the file uses 'optimasi', so 'optimisasi' is inconsistent. 'Keberlanjutan' is the ordinary Indonesian word, so keeping the English with a gloss in brackets is unnecessary.

examples.source: requires an objective and constraints that represent the intended application
examples.translation: memerlukan objektif dan constraint yang merepresentasikan aplikasi yang dimaksud
examples.suggested: memerlukan fungsi objektif dan kendala yang merepresentasikan aplikasi yang dimaksud
examples.why: 'Kendala' is the conventional Indonesian optimization term for a constraint. 'Objektif' on its own reads as a calqued noun.

examples.source: when the noise swamps the actual cost improvements per step, its linear-approximation model
examples.translation: ketika noise menenggelamkan perbaikan biaya nyata per langkah (yakni penurunan biaya), model aproksimasi liniernya
examples.suggested: ketika noise menenggelamkan perbaikan biaya nyata per langkah, model aproksimasi liniernya
examples.why: The bracketed gloss is not in the source. It is harmless but redundant, because the same sentence later says 'penurunan nyata'.

examples.source: and the optimizer wanders
examples.translation: dan pengoptimal pun mengembara
examples.suggested: dan pengoptimal pun bergerak tanpa arah
examples.why: 'Mengembara' is a literal calque of 'wanders'. An Indonesian technical writer would describe aimless parameter drift differently.

editor_note: I checked all 12 rewritten entries against the English and none would mislead a learner. Quantities, conditions and caveats all survive: O(N^2), N(N+1)/2, row 15/column 20, "not optimized", and "no backend-specific optimization is required". The flaws are in the wording of entries 18 and 47. In entry 18, "feature-mapped space" becomes "ruang yang telah dipetakan oleh fitur" ("space mapped by the features"), which garbles the idea of the space the feature map maps into, and the sentence opens with a dangling English-style participle ("Mengambil vektor-vektor ... sebagai argumen, fungsi kernel ..."). In entry 47, "Agar ... , oleh karena itu kita menjalankan" says "therefore" twice, and it reads stiffly.

examples.source: Taking the vectors in the feature-mapped space as arguments, kernel function ... returns their inner product
examples.translation: Mengambil vektor-vektor dalam ruang yang telah dipetakan oleh fitur sebagai argumen, fungsi kernel ... mengembalikan hasil kali dalam keduanya
examples.suggested: Dengan vektor-vektor di ruang hasil pemetaan fitur sebagai argumen, fungsi kernel ... mengembalikan hasil kali dalam keduanya
examples.why: 'dipetakan oleh fitur' says the features do the mapping; the space is the output of the feature map. The sentence also copies the English dangling-participle structure.

examples.source: the inner product in the feature-mapped space
examples.translation: hasil kali dalam di ruang yang dipetakan fitur
examples.suggested: hasil kali dalam di ruang hasil pemetaan fitur
examples.why: Same calque, and it is rendered differently from the earlier 'dipetakan oleh fitur' in the same paragraph. Use one rendering that makes clear this is the feature map's output space.

examples.source: To keep the demo short and to make a clean comparison, we therefore run the same seven-qubit instance
examples.translation: Agar demo tetap singkat dan perbandingan bersih, oleh karena itu kita menjalankan instans tujuh-qubit yang sama
examples.suggested: Karena itu, agar demo tetap singkat dan perbandingannya bersih, kita menjalankan instans tujuh-qubit yang sama
examples.why: Putting 'oleh karena itu' after an 'Agar' purpose clause is redundant and ungrammatical-sounding in Indonesian. Move the connective to the front.

editor_note: I checked the three rewritten step headings (67, 69, 70) against the English, and none of them changes the meaning or would mislead a learner. The one problem is that entry 70 breaks the heading pattern. It uses commands ("Lakukan pascapemrosesan dan kembalikan hasil…"), while Steps 1–3 all start with a verb naming the action: "Memetakan", "Mengoptimalkan", "Menjalankan". It should read "Melakukan pascapemrosesan dan mengembalikan hasil…". The use of "hardware kuantum" in entry 67 is defensible even though entry 19 says "perangkat keras", and "pascapemrosesan" follows standard spelling for "pasca-" words.

examples.source: Step 4: Post-process and return results in classical format
examples.translation: Langkah 4: Lakukan pascapemrosesan dan kembalikan hasil dalam format klasik
examples.suggested: Langkah 4: Melakukan pascapemrosesan dan mengembalikan hasil dalam format klasik
examples.why: Steps 1–3 all start with a verb naming the action (Memetakan / Mengoptimalkan / Menjalankan). Only Step 4 switches to commands, which breaks the pattern of the four-step series.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. I checked the caveats closely: the result lands 23.7 kcal/mol above the reference and misses chemical accuracy, the removed (24, 24)/(20, 20) interactions are kept, and so is the note that install commands don't pin versions. Nothing here would mislead a learner. The noun "run" is rendered as the imperative verb "jalankan" in [42], [74], [75] and [76] ("dari jalankan hardware kontributor", "Akurasi dari jalankan yang tersimpan", "Jalankan SQD di bawah ini mendemonstrasikan"). This is ungrammatical, and at the start of [75] it reads like a command. Separately, "quantum" and "kuantum" are mixed inside the same file: "workload kuantum" / "kimia kuantum" in [0], [1] and [10], but "hardware quantum" / "resource quantum" / "kimia quantum" in [19], [21], [28] and [70].

examples.source: The SQD run below demonstrates successful end-to-end QRMI execution
examples.translation: Jalankan SQD di bawah ini mendemonstrasikan eksekusi QRMI end-to-end yang berhasil
examples.suggested: Eksekusi SQD di bawah ini menunjukkan bahwa eksekusi QRMI end-to-end berhasil
examples.why: 'Jalankan' is an imperative verb, so it can't be the subject noun. The sentence opens like a command ('Run SQD...').

examples.source: Accuracy of the saved run
examples.translation: Akurasi dari jalankan yang tersimpan
examples.suggested: Akurasi hasil eksekusi yang tersimpan
examples.why: Same misuse of the verb 'jalankan' as a noun. It also appears in [42] and [76].

examples.source: a complete quantum chemistry workflow
examples.translation: alur kerja kimia quantum yang lengkap
examples.suggested: alur kerja kimia kuantum yang lengkap
examples.why: [0] and [10] render the same phrase as 'kimia kuantum'. Across the file, 'quantum' and 'kuantum' alternate with no pattern.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries are faithful. Entry 0 ("Gunakan wire cutting untuk mempartisi circuit menjadi banyak subcircuit yang lebih kecil") and entry 8 ("Menggunakan primitive [Sampler] ..., yang digunakan dalam alur kerja ini") keep circuit, subcircuit and primitive the same way the rest of the page does.
